description: Returns a PDF of a full web page, rendered in a real browser (JavaScript executed). The response body is the file, not JSON. Cached for 24 hours per URL; X-Cached and X-Fetched-At response headers report cache status and fetch time. Costs $0.01 per call via x402.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page to convert to PDF.

name: tariffmonkee-pdf
